reviews.text: One of the best groomers I’ve ever been to, especially for golden doodles
I took my goldendoodle to Lovely Pets for the first time and it was great! They did a good job of taking care of my dog and grooming him well. Thank you and we’ll definitely be going back!

Luis was the only groomer took my dog after months of no one would give service to gunner.  My dog can be sweet but is very territorial so has his character; so Luis knew how to manage gunner in a very sweet way. When I went to pick him up he was very happy. I’m finally have a wonderful groomer. The place is very cozy and clean. Thank you Luis you are the best!!
The owner provided excellent customer service. Both our Pitbull and Shiba-Inu love coming here. Highly recommend!
Very professional. I was very pleased with the service.
Hello, thank you so much for your review! You are always welcome here. We look forward to seeing you again soon

Excellent service! Luis and his team treated our chow chow wonderfully. The attention was fantastic, and they left him spotless and beautiful.
Highly recommended!
